BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: Exploitation typically requires access to the vulnerable application logic or environment where the hardcoded cryptographic keys or IVs are used.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: No special conditions are required to exploit this issue.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No special privileges are required beyond access to the vulnerable functionality.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact is limited to the same application scope.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Hardcoded keys or IVs can expose encrypted sensitive data to unauthorized disclosure.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Attackers may be able to alter or forge protected data because the cryptographic material is predictable or recoverable.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Availability impact is limited, but compromised cryptographic operations may affect application reliability or trust in protected data.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is well known and demonstrable.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is clearly identified by static analysis.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_VECTOR
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: The deployment environment does not significantly change how the vulnerable cryptographic implementation is accessed.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: No additional complexity is introduced by the deployment environment.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: No additional privileges are required in the deployed environment.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_INTEGRITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: The ability to tamper with or forge protected data remains a significant concern.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_AVAILABILITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Availability impact remains limited in this environment.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: CONFIDENTIALITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Protecting sensitive encrypted data is critical in this environment.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: INTEGRITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Maintaining the integrity of cryptographically protected data is critical.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: AVAILABILITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Availability matters, but it is less critical than confidentiality and integrity for this issue.
